sections.heading: B.1 Proof of Theorem 4.1
sections.text: Let attn(x_{i})=({\bm{W}}_{q}{\bm{x}}_{i})^{T}{\bm{W}}_{k}{\bm{X}}_{:i} be the original attention layer of LLM, and attn^{\prime}(x_{i})=\left(({\bm{W}}_{q}+\Delta{\bm{W}}_{q}){\bm{x}}_{i}\right)^{T}({\bm{W}}_{k}+\Delta{\bm{W}}_{k}){\bm{X}}_{:i} be the fine-tuned one and \widehat{attn} be desired function, can we fine-tune the model to be \widehat{attn}? So we need softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{X}}))[i]\approx\begin{cases}0&\text{ if }\ \exists\ b\ s.t.\ g_{1}(x_{i},x_{b})=0\\ softmax(attn({\bm{X}}_{r}))[i]&\text{ else }\end{cases} where {\bm{X}}_{r} means those related tokens. let {\bm{A}}_{i,j}=attn({\bm{x}}_{i},{\bm{x}}_{j})=({\bm{W}}_{q}{\bm{x}}_{i})^{T}{\bm{W}}_{k}{\bm{x}}_{j}={\bm{x}}_{i}^{T}{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j} \begin{split}attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i},{\bm{x}}_{j})&=\left(({\bm{W}}_{q}+\Delta{\bm{W}}_{q}){\bm{x}}_{i}\right)^{T}({\bm{W}}_{k}+\Delta{\bm{W}}_{k}){\bm{x}}_{j}\\ &={\bm{x}}_{i}({\bm{W}}+\Delta{\bm{W}}){\bm{x}}_{j}\\ &={\bm{x}}_{i}{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j}\end{split} where \Delta{\bm{W}}=\Delta{\bm{W}}_{q}{\bm{W}}_{k}+{\bm{W}}_{q}\Delta{\bm{W}}_{k}+\Delta{\bm{W}}_{q}\Delta{\bm{W}}_{k} Then, to effectively separate noise information, we require the attention score of the noise to be small and the attention score of useful information to be large, so to filter out noise, we require \Delta{\bm{W}}_{q}^{\prime},\Delta{\bm{W}}_{k}^{\prime} satisfying {\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j}\begin{cases}\leq c_{l}&\text{if $x_{j}$ is noise},\\ \in[c_{h},c_{h}+\xi_{r}]&\text{else},\end{cases} (2) where c_{l} and c_{h} are constants and c_{h}>c_{l} if {\bm{x}}_{j} is a noise token and {\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j}=c_{l}, then \begin{split}softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]-0&=softmax(A_{i,:}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{X}})[j]\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{j})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k})}\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+c_{l})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k})}\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+c_{l}-c_{h})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k}-c_{h})}\\ \end{split} if we need softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]-0\leq\epsilon, let A_{i,j}=\max(A_{i,:}), then \displaystyle\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+c_{l}-c_{h})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k}-c_{h})}\leq softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]-0\leq\epsilon \displaystyle\exp(A_{i,j}+c_{l}-c_{h})\leq\epsilon\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k}-c_{h}) \displaystyle c_{l}-c_{h}\leq\ln\left(\epsilon\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+{\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k}-c_{h})\right)-A_{i,j} \displaystyle c_{l}-c_{h}\leq\ln\left(\epsilon n\exp(A_{i,j}+\xi_{r})\right)-A_{i,j} \displaystyle c_{l}-c_{h}\leq\xi_{r}+\ln\epsilon n else if {\bm{x}}_{j} is a relevant token, let c=c_{h}, and \sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}}) denotes the summation of all relevant tokens, we consider a simple case where {\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{j}=c_{h}, and for one token {\bm{x}}_{k1}, we have {\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k1}=c_{h}+\xi_{r}, and for all other relevant tokens we have {\bm{x}}_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}{\bm{x}}_{k}=c_{h} \begin{split}&\hskip 15.00002ptsoftmax(\hat{attn}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]-softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j})}{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}-\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{j})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k})}\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j})}{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}-\frac{\exp(A_{i,j}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{j}-c)}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k}-c)}\\ &=\frac{\exp(A_{i,j})}{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}-\frac{\exp(A_{i,j})}{\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k}-c)}\\ \end{split} (3) considering softmax(\hat{attn}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]-softmax(attn^{\prime}({\bm{x}}_{i}))[j]=c(\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b})\leq\epsilon\frac{c}{a}, c=\exp(A_{i,j}), a=\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}}), b=\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k}-c) \displaystyle b-a\leq\epsilon b \displaystyle(1-\epsilon)b\leq a \displaystyle b\leq\frac{a}{1-\epsilon} \displaystyle\sum_{k}\exp(A_{i,k}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k}-c)\leq\frac{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}{1-\epsilon} \displaystyle\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}}+x_{i}\Delta{\bm{W}}x_{k}-c)\leq\frac{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}{1-\epsilon} \displaystyle\sum_{k^{\prime}-k1}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})+\exp(A_{i,k1}+\xi_{r})\leq\frac{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})}{1-\epsilon} \displaystyle\exp(A_{i,k1}+\xi_{r})\leq\frac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}\sum_{k^{\prime}-k}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})+\frac{\exp(A_{i,k1})}{1-\epsilon} \displaystyle\xi_{r}\leq\ln\left(\frac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}\sum_{k^{\prime}-k}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})+\frac{\exp(A_{i,k1})}{1-\epsilon}\right)-A_{i,k1} Considering the case that \frac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}\sum_{k^{\prime}-k}\exp(A_{i,k^{\prime}})\approx 0, then we need \xi_{r}\lesssim\ln\frac{1}{1-\epsilon} Theorem B.1 . if there exists attn^{\prime}(x_{i},x_{j})={\bm{x}}_{i}({\bm{W}}+\Delta{\bm{W}}){\bm{x}}_{j} satisfying attn^{\prime}(x_{i},x_{j})-\widehat{attn}(x_{i},x_{j})\leq\epsilon, then we need \begin{split}\xi_{r}&\lesssim\ln\frac{1}{1-\epsilon}\\ c_{l}-c_{h}&\leq\xi_{r}+\ln\epsilon n\end{split} As \epsilon\approx 0, so \ln\frac{1}{1-\epsilon}\approx 0
